meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 比较当前代码与最新发布的 npm 版本，阅读实际 diff 而非复制提交信息，按发布层分类未发布的更改，并为各层及整体推荐版本号。
howto.when: 当你说到「未发布的更改」、「changelog」、「what changed」等关键词时触发。

say.text: 看看有哪些未发布的更改。
say.note: 我会比较当前代码和已发布版本。

say.text: 和最新发布的 npm 版本对比，有什么改动？
say.note: 我会按发布层列出改动并推荐版本。

say.text: 列出所有未发布的 changelog。
say.note: 我会读取实际 diff，不复制提交信息。

howto.what_en: Claude compares HEAD with the latest published npm versions, reads actual diffs instead of copying commit messages, classifies unpublished changes by release layer, and recommends version bumps for each layer and overall.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', or similar keywords.

say_en.note: I'll compare the current code with the released versions.

say_en.text: Compare with the latest npm release, what's new?
say_en.note: I'll list changes by release layer and suggest a version bump.
I'll read the actual diffs, not copy commit messages.
